timeline.event: Defendant enters coffee shop and orders a Pastel de Nata.
Defendant is seen having a casual conversation with the cashier, who seems to recognize him as a regular customer.
Defendant is having his meal, a strange figure is seen lurking near his pocket.
Defendant tries to pay with a bill, the cashier looks at it and then at the defendant with a puzzled expression.
Cashier takes out a pen and marks the bill, which turns out to be counterfeit.
Defendant is confused and tries to explain himself, but the cashier calls the police.
Defendant is escorted out of the coffee shop by the police, still protesting his innocence. A moving shadow can be seen exiting the scene, lurking in the background.

facts.truth: The defendant is innocent and was framed by the strange figure who is actually the person in line witness.
The bill was indeed counterfeit, but the defendant had no knowledge of it and was set up by the person in line witness, who is the real culprit.
